tasks.label: Build Debug
tasks.command: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm dev make clean && docker compose run --rm dev make DEBUG=true PLATFORM=qemu_virt

tasks.label: Build Target
tasks.command: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm dev make clean && docker compose run --rm dev make kernel8.img DEBUG=false PLATFORM=rpi

tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm dev make clean

tasks.label: Start QEMU Debug Server
tasks.command: echo 'Starting QEMU debug server...' && qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt,gic-version=3 -cpu cortex-a53 -m 512M -kernel "${workspaceFolder}/kernel.elf" -nographic -S -s
